Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “RSL” as “reduced salinity level” instead of “relative sea level,” and then incorrectly tied this to changes in salinity/density. This led the Planner to misdescribe Option B as “steep drop in ocean salinity and density” (which actually matches Option A) and to give misleading instructions. This conceptual mix-up could directly steer the solution toward the wrong effect despite earlier correct reasoning about sea-level (volume/area) decline.
